text.name: Norse Ballista
text.description:
{Norse Ballista}

In battle the ballista shoots at enemy troops, its damage rising with the hero's Attack. With Artillery you can aim it yourself.
text.event: A Norse ballista lies abandoned in the snow, its arms still drawn and an iron-headed bolt in the groove. You have it hitched up and hauled into your column.

text.name: Mountain Giant Heart
text.event: Deep in the grotto, the fallen Mountain Giant's chest splits open, and a grey-white stone heart still beats slowly. You put the Mountain Giant Heart in your pack.

text.name: Rock Giant Heart
text.event: The Rock Giant crumbles into rubble, and a dark red stone heart rolls out. You pick up the Rock Giant Heart.

text.name: Frost Giant Heart
text.event: The chill of the cave fades, and the Frost Giant leaves behind a heart like an ice crystal, bitterly cold in your hand. You have obtained the Frost Giant Heart.

text.name: Fire Giant Heart
text.event: The flames of the rift slowly die, and in the Fire Giant's chest only a scorched heart still burns hot. You have obtained the Fire Giant Heart.

text.name: Gungnir
text.event: A spear stands in the frozen ground, the runes on its head glinting in the snowlight. Legend says Odin never misses when he throws it. This is Odin's spear Gungnir.

text.name: Gambanteinn
text.event: A raven drops a short wooden staff wound with silver wire at your feet, then settles on a branch to watch you. This is Odin's wand Gambanteinn.

text.name: Ullr's Bow
text.event: A line of ski tracks crosses the snowfield, ending at a stump where a long birch bow hangs, frost on its string. This is the bow of Ullr, god of the winter hunt.

text.name: Nibelung Ring
text.event: Wedged in a crack in the riverbed is a red-gold ring carved as a dragon biting its own tail. When you put it on, the gold in your purse seems to grow heavier. This is the Nibelung Ring.

text.name: Fenrir's Fetters
text.event: Tied to a broken length of chain is a ribbon so thin you can barely see it, yet no pull can tear it. With it the gods bound Fenrir. These are Fenrir's Fetters.

text.name: Dwarven Horseshoes
text.event: The roadside smithy has long been empty, but on the anvil lies a set of horseshoes inlaid with golden runes, still warm to the touch. These are horseshoes forged by dwarves.

text.name: Asgard Hoard
text.description:
{Asgard Hoard}

Attack +3, Spell Power +3, Knowledge +2, land movement +300.
Your troops deal +5% damage, and shooters suffer no range penalty; enemy troops Speed -1.
Provides 750 gold per day, scouting radius +1.
Einherjar Warband: souls +50%, and the Big Dipper lights 1 more star at the start of battle.

Combined from Gungnir, Gambanteinn, Ullr's Bow, the Nibelung Ring, Fenrir's Fetters and the Dwarven Horseshoes.
(The components are consumed when combined)
text.event: The six artifacts form a circle on the snow; their runes light one after another, and at last all are drawn into a golden chest bound with triple knots. As the lid closes you seem to hear singing from Valhalla. You have obtained the Asgard Hoard.
